purpose: Independent expected software outcomes authored before adapters; all materials, quantities and capabilities synthetic, not experimental recommendations.
status: Acceptance specifications, not executed tests or scientific validation.

cases.description: Move an explicitly added amount between two containers of one synthetic material.
cases.negative: Replacing added_uL with final_target_uL must not silently perform the same operation.

cases.description: Partition one synthetic sample into two outputs without losing common lineage.
cases.negative: Removing either lineage relation must block an export claiming identity preservation.

cases.description: Pool two explicitly nonreacting synthetic materials; preserve both identities rather than rename both as a generic liquid.
cases.negative: Treating both components as one shared reagent must fail identity preservation; no reaction yield may be inferred.

cases.description: A synthetic separation explicitly assigns target-T to a retained fraction and an unrelated marker to waste. This is stipulated fixture meaning, not a claim about a laboratory separation.
cases.negative: Swapping retained/discarded labels must not be a successful equivalent method or export.

cases.description: Three symbolic liquid exchanges with explicit retention, addition and withdrawal amounts.
cases.negative: Unknown repeat count must block quantitative consumption; this fixture makes no chemical washing-efficiency claim.

cases.description: A measured numeric signal selects one explicit branch; an unavailable measurement does not choose a default.
cases.negative: A syntactically valid activity graph that drops the guard must produce a semantic loss and cannot claim executable equivalence.

cases.description: Maximum delay between operations is separate from the duration of the second operation.
cases.negative: Replacing maximum delay with a 300-second incubation changes meaning.

cases.description: Two independent operations can overlap only if their equipment assignments do not conflict.
cases.negative: A missing resource assignment must remain unresolved rather than imply two available heaters.

cases.description: A synthetic transformation requires temperature and pressure simultaneously; separate maxima cannot be combined across incompatible modules.
cases.negative: Unioning the temperature maximum of A and pressure maximum of B must not create a feasible configuration. Numbers are synthetic software limits.

cases.description: Two inlet streams enter a connected volume; residence time has a value only under an explicitly selected ideal model and stated steady-state assumptions.
cases.negative: A UML/dataflow edge does not establish tubing, pressure compatibility, mixing quality or physical execution readiness.
